checks.name: Complete two-floor mixed company loads, building view keeps no indoor resources
Both floors show their own real models without changing any logical data
Normal-height walls cut away selectively and viewing never changes saved or physical data
A disabled lamp does not consume the light budget and room focus uses only that room
Combined edit keeps attached devices in the actual transformed desk frame
All four sofa resources remain usable through the existing human preview controls
Explicit template upgrade retains mixed resources and the edited local configuration
All floors and edited states survive complete browser-process closure and can be edited again
Mixed resource errors preserve the complete company and last durable save
Repeated mixed-floor viewing returns to warmed allocation baselines with bounded lights

limits: Company production and display only; no real actors or occupancy acceptance.
Short allocation-count checks are not GPU memory, long-duration stability or ordinary-PC performance acceptance.
